failure_patterns.pattern: incomplete_offer_coverage: Agents missed qualifying offers or price ties by not systematically expanding from initial candidates to model variants and all relevant listings.
overly_narrow_search: Specific compound queries missed relevant products with differently worded attributes or models.
incomplete_multi_shop_checkout: The agent confirmed one order but did not complete the separate checkout required for an item in another shop’s cart.
attribute_misinterpretation: Counted RGB-header support for attaching LED strips as proof that the motherboard itself has RGB lighting.
